Fonepay wishes every user a Dashain and Tihar filled with family, good health, and safe journeys home. This festive season, we want to make sure distance is never the reason someone misses tika, or misses seeing their family. With Fonepay, getting there comes with a little extra — cashback on every flight booked through your own mobile banking app. 

Fonepay Dashain-Tihar Offer - Super Yatra 2083 

The Super Yatra campaign is back for the Dashain-Tihar festive season, running through Fonepay Bills. Whether you're flying home for tika, heading back for Bhai Tika, or just making sure you don't miss a single family gathering this festive season, Fonepay makes booking your flight quick — and rewarding. 

Book your domestic flight ticket directly from your mobile banking app's Fonepay Bills section, and get cashback credited straight to your account. 

Here's what you get: 

  • New users: Rs. 500 cashback on your first flight booking 

  • Existing users: Rs. 200 cashback on your flight booking 

Use the promo code YATRA83 at checkout to claim your cashback. This offer runs through November 16, 2026. Each user can claim the cashback only once during the campaign period, regardless of how many flights are booked. 

Don't let a missed ticket be the reason you're not home this Dashain-Tihar, book now and travel smart. 

  • Campaign Name: Super Yatra 2083 

  • Duration: Ashoj 12, 2083 – Kartik 30,2083 (September 28 – November 16, 2026)

How to Book Your Flight Ticket via Fonepay Bills 

  1. Log in to your mobile banking app. 

  1. Go to the 'Payments' section and find 'Fonepay Bills.' 

  1. Tap on 'Domestic Flights.' 

  1. Follow the on-screen steps to search and select your flight. 

  1. Fill in the required booking details, then look for the promo code field. 

  1. Enter the promo code YATRA83 

  1. Review your details and tap 'Confirm' to complete the booking. 

  1. Your cashback will be credited to your linked bank account.
